Dear [Mrs Holbeach](/person/706)
Thank you very much for your sweet story.

It is a very happy recollection.

How good of you to send it in the midst of your own care and sorrow

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Envelope addressed to ‘Mrs Holbeach/ Farnborough Hall/ Banbury’.
